name: Gol'Bolar Quarry
summary: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, troggs have driven the miners from their work in the snowy hills of southeastern Dun Morogh. The Ironforge dwarves came for stone and ore, but the excavation has fallen silent.

sections.title: A Quarry Under Siege
sections.body: Gol'Bolar Quarry lies southeast of Kharanos, where Ironforge dwarves came to draw stone and minerals from the mountains. Deep digging opened underground warrens, and hostile troggs drove the miners out. Now the upper camp is a staging ground under siege. Overseers, tradesfolk, and Prospector Gehn gather dwarven and gnomish recruits there to drive back the beasts and reclaim the pit.

faq.answer: Gol'Bolar Quarry is an open-pit mine in southeastern Dun Morogh. Ironforge dwarves maintain it as an excavation site and a small outpost with supplies and work for local adventurers.

faq.q: Why are there so many troggs here?
faq.answer: Dwarven miners dug too deeply and broke into tunnels inhabited by troggs. The creatures swarmed into the open pits and nearby mine shafts, forcing the miners back to the quarry's upper rim.
Prospector Gehn is a dwarven supervisor at the quarry camp. He oversees efforts to secure the dig site and issues bounties and tasks to adventurers willing to cull the troggs.

angles.text: Exposed rock tiers and nearby tunnels hold plentiful mineral veins, but entrenched troggs stand between you and the ore.
As a dwarf, clearing Gol'Bolar Quarry means protecting Ironforge's mountain resources and upholding clan pride. The dwarves cannot afford to let the troggs seize them.
